description: Single source of truth for every telemetry channel and every limit. Code must read limits from here; nothing may hardcode a threshold. Relative limits are offsets from the baseline for the current operating mode (see config/modes.json); absolute limits are plain values. hard_limits are absolute and apply in every mode.

record_fields.name: t_s
record_fields.description: Seconds since scenario start (mission elapsed time)

record_fields.name: op_mode
record_fields.description: Operating mode reported by the robot; one of the ids in config/modes.json

hierarchy.note: SYSTEM = one robot. Every channel belongs to exactly one component; every component to exactly one subsystem.

channels.name: wheel_fl_current_a
channels.label: Front-left drive motor current
channels.justification: Rises for bearing_wear and wheel_drag (extra load torque, I = tau/K_t). Staying normal is what separates cooling_fault from bearing_wear.
channels.source: team estimate (derived from DECISIONS.md section 4 equations with team-estimate parameters); hard limit 8.0 A = assumed motor-driver current limit (team estimate)

channels.name: wheel_fl_speed_rads
channels.label: Front-left wheel speed
channels.justification: Required by HUNCH (Mission 1 displays wheel speed; Mission 2 names unusual wheel speed). For our four faults it is confirming evidence, not strictly needed: a real load increase (bearing_wear, wheel_drag) must also slow the wheel, which rules out a faulty current sensor; normal for cooling_fault. The detector's thermal model also needs it for bearing friction heat.
channels.source: team estimate (derived from DECISIONS.md section 4 equations with team-estimate parameters)

channels.name: wheel_fl_temp_c
channels.label: Front-left drive temperature
channels.justification: The only channel that separates bearing_wear (excess heat beyond what current explains) from wheel_drag (heat fully explained by current). Primary channel for cooling_fault.
channels.source: team estimate (derived from DECISIONS.md section 4 equations with team-estimate parameters); hard limit 90 degC = assumed motor insulation / grease limit (team estimate)

channels.name: battery_voltage_v
channels.label: Battery pack terminal voltage
channels.justification: Primary channel for battery_degradation: terminal voltage sags further below the model value V_oc(SOC) - I*R_nominal as internal resistance rises.
channels.source: team estimate (derived from DECISIONS.md section 4 equations with team-estimate parameters); 42.0 V cut-off and 54.6 V (13 x 4.2 V) max are typical Li-ion values, team estimate until a cell is chosen

channels.name: battery_current_a
channels.label: Battery pack current (+ = discharge)
channels.justification: Needed to judge sag 'under load': the voltage residual only means something when the load current is known (sag = I * delta_R).
channels.source: team estimate (derived from DECISIONS.md section 4 equations with team-estimate parameters); hard limits are assumed pack charge/discharge ratings (team estimate)

channels.name: battery_soc_pct
channels.label: Battery state of charge
channels.justification: Needed to compute the expected open-circuit voltage V_oc(SOC); without it a low voltage from a flat battery looks like degradation. Also the 'battery level' Mission 1 must display.

channels.name: lift_joint_current_a
channels.label: Cargo-lift actuator current
channels.justification: Not needed by any of the four PDR faults. Included because HUNCH requires joint telemetry and Mission 1 must display joint status. See open question Q3.

channels.name: lift_joint_pos_err_deg
channels.label: Cargo-lift position error
channels.justification: Not needed by any of the four PDR faults. Included for HUNCH joint-status coverage (the deck names actuator position error). See open question Q3.
